utc-dates.rule: date arithmetic gives the same answer in every timezone: no local-time Date accessors, and no reading the real clock

c-1-1.check: GET /api/habits returns 200 with a JSON array of 4 habits, each carrying id, name, streak and a days array of exactly 7 entries

c-1-2.check: GET /api/habits returns every habit's days[].date as the strings 2026-08-24, 2026-08-25, 2026-08-26, 2026-08-27, 2026-08-28, 2026-08-29, 2026-08-30 in that Monday-to-Sunday order

c-1-3.check: GET /api/habits returns streak 5 for id drink-water, 0 for id read-pages, 0 for id meditate and 1 for id stretch

c-1-4.check: screen / renders 4 elements with data-testid habit-row, and the row with data-habit-id drink-water contains a data-testid habit-streak element whose text is exactly Streak: 5

c-1-5.check: screen / renders 7 elements with data-testid day-cell inside the habit-row with data-habit-id drink-water, and data-done is the string true on data-date 2026-08-24, 2026-08-25 and 2026-08-26 and the string false on the other 4 cells

c-1-6.check: with $APP_DIR/data/habits.json written so trackedDay is 2026-08-30, a Sunday, GET /api/habits returns every habit's days[].date as 2026-08-24, 2026-08-25, 2026-08-26, 2026-08-27, 2026-08-28, 2026-08-29, 2026-08-30 in that order; and with $APP_DIR/data/habits.json written so trackedDay is 2026-09-06, GET /api/habits returns every habit's days[].date as 2026-08-31, 2026-09-01, 2026-09-02, 2026-09-03, 2026-09-04, 2026-09-05, 2026-09-06 in that order

c-2-1.check: GET /api/habits/drink-water returns 200 with name Drink water, a days array of exactly 7 entries and streak 5

c-2-2.check: GET /api/habits/no-such-habit returns 404 with a JSON body whose error key holds a non-empty string

c-2-3.check: screen /habits/read-pages renders 7 elements with data-testid day-cell, with data-done the string true on data-date 2026-08-24 and 2026-08-25 and the string false on the other 5 cells

c-2-4.check: screen /habits/stretch displays a data-testid habit-name element whose text is exactly Stretch and a data-testid habit-streak element whose text is exactly Streak: 1

c-2-5.check: screen /habits/no-such-habit displays an element with data-testid habit-missing whose text is exactly Habit not found, renders 0 elements with data-testid day-cell, and renders no habit-name element and no habit-streak element

c-3-1.check: POST /api/habits/stretch/toggle with body {"date": "2026-08-25"} returns 200 with streak 2 and the days entry for 2026-08-25 marked done

c-3-2.check: POST /api/habits/drink-water/toggle with body {"date": "2026-08-26"} returns 200 with streak 0, and a following GET /api/habits/drink-water persists streak 0 and 2 days marked done in the week

c-3-3.check: POST /api/habits/read-pages/toggle twice with body {"date": "2026-08-26"} returns 200 both times, streak 3 on the first response and streak 0 with 2 days marked done on the second

c-3-4.check: POST /api/habits/no-such-habit/toggle with body {"date": "2026-08-26"} returns 404; POST /api/habits/stretch/toggle returns 400 for body {}, for body {"date": "not-a-date"} and for body {"date": "2026-08-31"}; each of those 4 responses carries a JSON body whose error key holds a non-empty string; and after one GET /api/habits has materialised $APP_DIR/data/habits.json from the seed, that file is byte-for-byte identical before and after the 4 requests

c-3-5.check: clicking the day-cell with data-date 2026-08-26 in the habit-row with data-habit-id meditate on screen / updates that cell's data-done to the string true and that row's habit-streak text to Streak: 1, leaves the drink-water row's habit-streak text at Streak: 5, and the browser issues exactly 1 GET request whose path is /api/habits from opening screen / to the end of that click
